verdict.rationale: Browserbase's SDK offers natural-language selectors that replace hand-written CSS/XPath, its fetch can turn any URL into JSON, and its agents are documented as pulling data from websites. No document says an LLM reads a page and decides which structured fields to extract. missing for 10: documented LLM-driven structured extraction where the model chooses the fields, schema or output-format details, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors

citations.quote: The SDK for browser agents. Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
